prompt.description: The text description of the scene, subject, or action to generate in the video.

image_url.description: The URL of the image strictly used as the first frame of the video. Cannot be used together with reference media, file_url, or link_url.

last_image_url.description: The URL of the image strictly used as the last frame of the video. Requires image_url.

reference_image_urls.description: Array of image URLs for multi-image-to-video generation.

video_urls.description: Reference video URLs. Up to 5 clips with a total duration of no more than 15 seconds.

audio_urls.description: Reference audio URLs. Up to 5 clips with a total duration of no more than 15 seconds.

file_url.description: The URL of a document (docx, doc, xlsx, xls, pptx, ppt, pdf, txt, key, pages, numbers, md) the model uses to generate the video. Cannot be used together with link_url.

link_url.description: The URL of a publicly accessible web page the model uses to generate the video. Cannot be used together with file_url.

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated video.

resolution.description: An enumeration where the short side of the video frame determines the resolution.

duration.description: The length of the output video in seconds, from 2 to 30. When reference videos are provided, the total input video duration plus the output video duration must not exceed 30 seconds.

generate_audio.description: Specifies whether the output video contains audio.

seed.description: Varying the seed integer is a way to get different results for the same other request parameters. Using the same value for an identical request will produce similar results. If unspecified, a random number is chosen.

watermark.description: Whether the video contains a watermark.

id.description: The ID of the generated video.

status.description: The current status of the generation task.

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

error.description: Description of the error, if any.

credits_used.description: The number of tokens consumed during generation.

usd_spent.description: The total amount of money spent by the user in USD.

provider.description: Provider routing override, pinning the request to one provider and disabling fallback. Seedance 2.5 runs on native ByteDance only, so `auto` (default) and `bytedance` behave identically today. Unlike Seedance 2.0 there is no Tencent Cloud VOD link, so reference images containing real people are rejected upstream. Case-insensitive.

prompt.description: The text description of the scene, subject, or action to generate in the video.

image_url.description: A direct link to an online image or a Base64-encoded local image that will serve as the visual base or the first frame for the video.

last_image_url.description: A direct link to an online image or a Base64-encoded local image to be used as the last frame of the video.

audio_url.description: URL, Base64-encoded string or asset ID of the audio. The duration of the audio file specified in the parameter must not exceed 15.2 seconds. If audio is provided, at least one reference image or video is required.

video_url.description: The public URL of the video. Only video URLs are supported.

image_urls.description: Reference images to guide video generation. Refer to them in the prompt as @Image1, @Image2, etc.

audio_urls.description: Reference audio to guide video generation. Refer to them in the prompt as @Audio1, @Audio2, etc. Supported formats: MP3, WAV. Up to 3 files, combined duration must not exceed 15 seconds. If audio is provided, at least one reference image (image_urls) or video (video_urls) is required.

video_urls.description: Reference videos to guide video generation. Refer to them in the prompt as @Video1, @Video2, etc. Supported formats: MP4, MOV. Each video must be between ~480p (640x640) and ~720p (834x1112) in resolution.

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated video. Defaults to 16:9 for text-to-video and reference-to-video requests. Must be omitted for first-frame / first-last-frame generation (`image_url`): the output aspect ratio follows the input image.

resolution.description: An enumeration where the short side of the video frame determines the resolution.

duration.description: The length of the output video in seconds.

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio for the video.

seed.description: Varying the seed integer is a way to get different results for the same other request parameters. Using the same value for an identical request will produce similar results. If unspecified, a random number is chosen.

watermark.description: Whether the video contains a watermark.

id.description: The ID of the generated video.

status.description: The current status of the generation task.

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

error.description: Description of the error, if any.

credits_used.description: The number of tokens consumed during generation.

usd_spent.description: The total amount of money spent by the user in USD.

prompt.description: The text description of the scene, subject, or action to generate in the video.

last_image_url.description: A direct link to an online image or a Base64-encoded local image to be used as the last frame of the video.

reference_image_urls.description: Subject or style reference images, referred to in the prompt as Image 1, Image 2, and so on. Reference images, videos and audio clips must add up to at most 12 files.

video_urls.description: Motion reference video clips of 2-15 seconds each and at most 15 seconds combined, referred to in the prompt as Video 1, Video 2, and so on. Reference images, videos and audio clips must add up to at most 12 files.

audio_urls.description: Reference audio clips of 2-15 seconds each and at most 15 seconds combined, referred to in the prompt as Audio 1, Audio 2, and so on. Cannot be the only reference — pass at least one reference image or video alongside. Reference images, videos and audio clips must add up to at most 12 files.

ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated video. This parameter is ignored if image_url is provided. Defaults to `adaptive`, which lets the model choose the ratio and requires a reference input; text-only generation cannot be `adaptive` and defaults to `16:9` instead.

resolution.description: The resolution of the output video, where the number refers to the short side in pixels.

duration.description: The length of the output video in seconds. 5 to 10 seconds is the recommended range.

prompt_expansion_mode.description: How much effort the model spends rewriting the prompt before generation. `balanced` returns in about a second; `quality` spends up to 30 seconds on a richer prompt.

enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled.

seed.description: Varying the seed integer is a way to get different results for the same other request parameters. Using the same value for an identical request will produce similar results. If unspecified, a random number is chosen.

id.description: The ID of the generated video.

status.description: The current status of the generation task.

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

error.description: Description of the error, if any.

credits_used.description: The number of tokens consumed during generation.

usd_spent.description: The total amount of money spent by the user in USD.

provider.description: Provider routing override, pinning the request to one provider and disabling fallback. `auto` (default) uses the full Tencent Cloud VOD -> native ByteDance -> fal.ai chain. `tencent_vod` is the only provider that accepts reference images containing real people (it registers them as assets first); pinning `bytedance` or `fal` sends the images straight to a provider that rejects them with "the input image may contain real person". Case-insensitive.
